business_problem: Virbe, a Polish startup that automates communication and sales activities, wanted to enable businesses to interact with customers through AI-powered avatars.
solution_summary: Virbe, a Polish startup that automates communication and sales activities, wanted to enable businesses to interact with customers through AI-powered avatars. Using Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI Service, and Azure AI Search, Virbe enhanced its AI avatars and simplified engagement with enterprise customers. With guidance from Microsoft, it also introduced its product on the Azure Marketplace as a transactable app, increasing its reach. Microsoft Azure quickly became Virbe's go-to platform. "None of the other cloud providers offered the variety of services in one platform," recalls Wróbel. Virbe could deploy its product directly on customers' Azure accounts, giving them full control over their data and enabling them to meet local legal requirements for data privacy and security. Virbe introduced Azure OpenAI Service to power the conversational flow, allowing the avatar to engage naturally. It then used Azure AI Search to pull up relevant company-specific information.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs the large-language-model features for classification, summarization, retrieval, or conversational responses in the solution.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Search
solution_components.role: Indexes enterprise content and retrieves relevant passages for AI-powered search and answer experiences.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Services
solution_components.role: Supplies pretrained AI capabilities such as vision, language, or speech inside the business workflow.

data_flow: Source content is gathered from the organization's documents and knowledge repositories, Azure OpenAI Service interprets or generates responses from that content, and the resulting answers or assessments are surfaced to employees or citizens through the application workflow.
business_outcome: With an endlessly customizable product, Virbe's customers have achieved significant benefits, such as a 25% engagement rate and up to a 10x increase in leads.
metrics: With an endlessly customizable product, Virbe's customers have achieved significant benefits, such as a 25% engagement rate and up to a 10x increase in leads.

The avatars are already attracting eyeballs. "A major retailer in Poland saw a 25% engagement rate using our product. Engaging a quarter of customers provides valuable insights to the retailer," adds Wróbel.
